title: Properties and applications of two melt-cast cocrystal carriers
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15276-15281
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02417J, Paper

Yunshu Zhao, Yibo Zhou, Jianping Song, Fei Wang, Xu Zhou, Xiaoyan Zhang, Shanhu Sun, Li Su, Zhirong Suo, Jinjiang Xu, Jie Sun
Cocrystal technology serves as an effective strategy to design and develop novel melt-cast carrier explosives. The feasibility of two energetic cocrystals (DNAN/NA and ADN/urea) as melt-cast carrier explosives was systematically evaluated.
